calculate_date_num_bins: calculate the number of date bins given a min, max, and interval with optional unknown bin
convert_date_to_bin: convert a current date value to its corresponding bin index within a date range
convert_bin_to_date: convert a bin index back to its representative date value
build_date_range_distribution: build a uniform probability distribution over date bins from a date range
compute_date_range_logits: compute log-probability logits for a date range distribution over bins
